title: Music Stock Pack v1 — 9 WAVs for $9
text: $9 gets 9 ready-to-edit WAV files: 3 original instrumental tracks × 60s / 30s / 15s. Built for SaaS demos, tutorials, app walkthroughs, coding and study content, presentations and social video. 48 kHz / 24-bit stereo. Music Stock Pack v1 is live at Stratum Praxis.
